newsitem.title: UK: Conrad sees Sheffield Utd news in few weeks.
newsitem.headline: Conrad sees Sheffield Utd news in few weeks.

text.p: Diversified leisurewear company Conrad Plc said on Thursday that it expected to make an announcement on its move to offer for first division Sheffield United Football Club within weeks.
In a statement accompanying its interim results, the company refered to its announcement in October that it had initiated discussions which may lead to the acquisition of Sheffield Utd.
"(We) expect to make a further announcement relating to this proposal in the course of the next few weeks," it said.
Commenting on Conrad's prospects, chairman Martyn Rose said he would be "naturally delighted if shareholders' patience is rewarded by the completion of the proposed acquisition".
